rows.details: North Eastern Indira Gandhi Regional Institute of Health & Medical Sciences (NEIGRIHMS)
EST-II-RJRDOAJRD/1/2024-Estt.II (updated vacancy against Rolling Advertisement dated 31.10.2025)
Level 10 of Pay Matrix, entry pay Rs.56,100/- plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under rules

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 14 vacancies for Junior Resident Doctors. One post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments as per Government of India policy. The notice does not give a department-wise break-up; it gives the reservation-wise table below. The Persons with Benchmark Disabilities reservation is one percent each for persons with benchmark disabilities under clauses (a), (b) and (c), and one percent for those under clauses (d) and (e): (a) Blindness and low vision (b) Deaf and hard of hearing (c) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy (d) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness (e) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) including deaf-blindness, in the posts identified for each disability EWS posts are not carried forward or treated as backlog vacancy if unfilled. Candidates of other categories may therefore apply provisionally, and are considered as UR candidates only if the EWS seat is otherwise not filled.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Persons possessing qualifications included in Part II of the 3rd Schedule must also fulfil the conditions specified in section 13(B) of the Act. The notice does not print an experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility. The age limit is 30 years, counted as on 18 November 2026, the last date for submitting applications (the notice uses this date to determine age, educational qualification and experience). Age is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates, in respect of vacancies reserved for them. Age relaxation for physically handicapped candidates is as per Govt. of India norms.

rows.qualification: Medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the 3rd Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956; satisfactory completion of the compulsory internship; registration with the Central/State Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 10 of Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs.56,100/- plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under rules. Accommodation: subject to availability, Resident Doctors are provided accommodation in the RMO Hostel. HRA: if no accommodation can be provided, HRA admissible as per rules is paid. Reservation and age relaxation are provided as per Govt. of India norms; EWS reservation follows the Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-(Estt (Res) dated 19 January 2019 and 31 January 2019.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctors
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email. Eligible candidates submit the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I, together with scanned copies of the self attested certificates listed below, to [email protected] by 18 November 2026, up to 5:30 p.m. Fill the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I. Add scanned copies of the self attested certificates named in the notice. EWS candidates attach the certificate issued by the competent authority in the form prescribed at Annexure-II. OBC (NCL) candidates produce the latest OBC (NCL) certificate issued by the Competent Authority during the current financial year, 1.4.2026 to 31.3.2027. Email the application to [email protected] so that it is sent by 18 November 2026, 5:30 p.m. The documents submitted are screened before the interview, and only eligible candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria are allowed to appear in the interview. The date of the interview will be published on the Institute's website. Candidates bring the original documents to the Institute at the time of interview. Candidates with disabilities produce the original physically handicapped certificate, with degree of disability, issued by the Competent Authority (a Medical Board duly constituted by the Central or State Govt.). For queries, contact [email protected] or Phone Nos 0364-2538020 or 0364-2539-215/216.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Two recent passport size photos Certificate of Date of Birth (10th certificate) Certificate of EWS/SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) from the competent authority, if applicable MBBS passed certificate MBBS marksheets MBBS attempt certificate MBBS internship completion certificate Medical registration certificate for MBBS NOC from the present employer (if employed) MCI/NMC eligibility certificate for candidates passing from foreign medical institutions Result of the screening test for Indian nationals with foreign medical qualifications, issued by the National Board of Examinations All certificates are scanned copies that are self attested.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident Doctors vacancies are there at NEIGRIHMS?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: UR 07, EWS 02, OBC 01, SC 03 and ST 01. One post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026 (Wednesday), up to 5:30 p.m. This is also the date for determining age, educational qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the 3rd Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, satisfactory completion of the compulsory internship, and registration with the Central/State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years as on 18 November 2026. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates, for vacancies reserved for them.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Junior Resident Doctor at NEIGRIHMS?
faq.answer: The pay is Level 10 of the Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs.56,100/- plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I with scanned self attested certificates by email to [email protected] by 18 November 2026, 5:30 p.m.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Submitted documents are screened before the interview, and only eligible candidates are allowed to appear in the interview. The interview date will be published on the Institute's website.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Subject to availability, Resident Doctors get accommodation in the RMO Hostel. If no accommodation can be provided, HRA admissible as per rules is paid.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot appear in the NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident interview?
faq.answer: Candidates who completed the 1 (one) year tenure as Junior Resident (house job) in State or Central Govt. or PSU/Autonomous bodies, and employed applicants without an NOC, will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. Is any post reserved for persons with disabilities?
faq.answer: Yes, 1 (one) post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments as per Government of India policy.
